# Retired library regression score

`tinh-don-phuong.mxl` preserves the original source formerly bundled in the public library.
It is test-only: the quality audit retired it because a G-sharp tie in bar 112 ends
on G-natural in bar 113. Keep it to test native page geometry, clefs, pedal marks,
and touch zoom. It is not installed in the public song library or used for grading.
